profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I enjoy writing code to solve problems. 
I am also an avid cyclist, runner, and photographer. Check out my portfolio in the link below!

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Create, contribute, & maintain internal tools & scripts for supporting IoT Validation team
- Implement CI/CD automated delivery flow for validation workspaces via Jenkins pipelines
- Design pytest unit test framework for validation codebase via Jenkins, Sonarqube coverage
- Integrate 3rd party lab instrument drivers into existing automation testing codebase

positions.title: Technician
positions.description: Assist with GM plant testing and configuration of PLCs and plant tracking systems

positions.title: Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Designed test infrastructure for ARM IP Subsystem Integration tool focusing on validating gRPC client server method calls
- Utilized Ontology Web Language (OWL) API, JUnit test library, Google remote procedural call library (gRPC) for both testing and development purposes
- Took active role with day-to-day planning and development 
- Reported and filed bugs and tasks, worked closely with full-time developers

positions.title: QA Intern
positions.description:
- Wrote tests for automating smoke and regression testing for Roku store partner channels
- Assisted Sr. QA engineers with maintaining automation framework and code base
- Analyzed automation CI build failures and filed bugs as needed

positions.title: QA Intern
positions.description:
- Developed automated Python test cases for set-top boxes and smart TVs to verify device functionality using PyUnit unit-testing library and Roku QA framework
- Created various Python wrapper methods for the QA framework
- Debugged and troubleshooted test failures to root cause using test output logs 
- Summarized bugs in nightly test results for senior QA engineers
- Prepared and upgraded test devices for developers and nightly testing lab
- Identified and reported issues pertinent to both customer and developer viewpoints

positions.title: Science and Engineering Apprenticeship Program
positions.description:
- Developed, researched, and programmed Ground Wave Propagation Simulator for simulating signal attenuation of vehicles’ changing distances from signal source
- Applied software development cycle process, debugging, documentation
- Presented Ground Wave Propagation Simulator to panel of professors and judges
- Utilized Java, NASA World Wind API, World Wind Documentation
- Demonstrated ability to work and plan independently with minimal supervision and achieve deadline goals

company.name: Applied Research Laboratories, The University of Texas at Austin

positions.title: Warehouse Operations
positions.description:
- Assisted with warehouse duties and responsibilities such as organizing caps and gowns, taking inventory, and sorting and labeling boxes
- Strengthened task prioritization and multitasking efficiency

projects.title: Arm IoT Security System - Senior Design
projects.description:
Home security system allowing for wireless, customizable security nodes (ie. motion, proximity) connected via Thread mesh network to continuously relay environment status to a website and mobile application

Project placed 1st in Industry category

projects.title: Ground Wave Propagation Simulator
projects.description: Java program which simulates the signal attenuation of a vehicle(s) transversing across terrain. Users can designate waypoints, measure distances, and name and place vehicles anywhere on the globe.
